issues.description: Stock clearing method name mismatch: the problem statement's UML and the solution implementation declare a Stock.emptyStock() method, but the template repository's Stock class defines the equivalent operation as clearInventory(). This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual operation (clearing the stock inventory) will confuse students and can cause compilation/test failures if automated tests or student code expect emptyStock().
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the specification and solution. Rename the template method clearInventory() to emptyStock(), or add a new emptyStock() method in the template that simply calls clearInventory(). Ensure any references are updated accordingly so students and tests consistently see Stock.emptyStock().
